observed_problem: The selected Hugging Face source was generated by querying Uniswap V3 pool.volumeToken0, pool.volumeToken1, pool.txCount and pool.token0Price at each block. The stored USDC and WETH columns are cumulative unsigned traded volumes, not pool balances and not signed token inventory deltas. Differencing them yields non-negative per-block volume but cannot identify whether WETH was bought or sold. Therefore the source cannot implement the preregistered completed inventory-transfer direction or forced hedge-flow side.
scientific_consequence: The dataset can measure cumulative and differenced unsigned activity, but not completed WETH purchase versus completed WETH sale.
Any sponsored-continuation or exhaustion-reversal direction inferred from these columns would be fabricated from price response rather than supplied by an external signed inventory source.
The exact source dependency is closed before labels, model fitting, actions, trades, PnL or official 2024 evaluation.
reopen_condition: Use canonical Swap logs or another point-in-time source containing signed amount0 and amount1, exact transaction/log identity and causally available block timestamps. Do not rescue this dataset with price-derived sign inference or adjacent thresholds.
